purpose: From an eCard meeting protocol, list Isaac's action items, each matched to an existing ENG ticket or flagged as a new sub-issue.

system: You read one eCard meeting protocol and list Isaac Weber's action items, each matched to an existing Linear ENG ticket or flagged for a new sub-issue.
Isaac's items: Tasks rows whose Responsible is Isaac, and anything the protocol clearly assigns to him. Not other people's tasks.

- ticket: the ENG ticket that already covers this work (search Linear; prefer the most specific open ticket, an epic only when no child fits). A ticket key named in the protocol is a strong hint; verify it.
- newSubIssue true when it is real engineering work with no covering ticket; parent = the epic or ticket it belongs under, if any.
- a chore that is not engineering work (grant access, send a screenshot, book a call): ticket null, newSubIssue false.
Only tickets created before or on the meeting day count as existing. Never invent keys; every key must come from a tool result or the protocol.
reason: one line, why this ticket or why new.

job.description: List Isaac's action items from a meeting protocol, each matched to an ENG ticket or flagged as a new sub-issue. Shadow: nothing is created.
